Candlesticks are timestamped by their start time.

markets.rules_primary: If the all-hours average real-time power price at ERCOT Houston Hub is above $100/MWh for the week ending November 6, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Period: October 30, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT to November 6, 2026 at 5:00 PM EST. Includes the start; excludes the end.
Source: ERCOT’s 15-minute real-time Settlement Point Prices (NP6-905-CD). Intervals follow ERCOT’s Central-time operating days and delivery-interval conventions; repeated daylight-saving intervals count separately.
Calculation: Simple average of all applicable 15-minute prices, including negative prices. Round the average to two decimals, with exact halves away from zero. Equality resolves No.
Trading closes: November 6, 2026 at 4:59 PM EST. The final delivery interval still counts.
Price versions: Use first published applicable prices. Later corrections count only if published before expiration and accepted by the Exchange as correcting a material error. Exclude unverified, estimated, indicative and forecast prices.
Missing data: Do not fill missing prices. At expiration, average the available prices if at least 95% of required intervals are available. Below 95%, resolve only if the available data establishes the outcome regardless of missing values; otherwise, settle at the Exchange-determined last fair price under the full rules.
